drk.text: Aylith is not made heir to her father Haen's Memories because she is female, but when Nohrish raiders attack Inys Haen and Thix sets it ablaze, Logan passes the Memories on to Aylith and dies. RoNal slays Thix and adopts Aylith.

In Inys Nohr, Nazir enchants Aylith into revealing the Memories, and Feryar shows her the last branch of the Tree, until Nazir strikes her down with Soulslayer and Feryar carries her away. Healed at Loch Prith, Aylith overcomes her inner darkness and chooses peace over vengeance, healing Nazir of his family's curse.
Aylith and Nazir recite the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending the fighting.

all.text: Nazir's soldiers raid Inys Haen and return with Aylith but not the Keeper alive, and Nazir interrogates and enchants her to extract the Memories of the Clan Tree. Facing rebellion, he strikes Aylith down with Soulslayer, but Feryar carries her away.

Nazir abandons his fortress and assaults Inys Haen, and Aylith pursues him, and when he is captured she chooses to heal him of his madness and addiction. Nazir then assists the Awakening Ritual, which causes the Mending of the Clan Tree and ends his reign.
